sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.content: By accessing the GameNotif application, you accept these Terms of Service in full. If you do not agree with any provision, please stop using the application and delete your account from the Settings screen.

sections.title: 2. Service description
sections.content: GameNotif aggregates and delivers news from the Steam ecosystem for the games you follow. The service is provided for informational purposes and may change or be discontinued at any time.

sections.title: 3. Use of the application
sections.content: You agree not to misuse the application, not to attempt to compromise its security, and not to collect or exploit data belonging to other users. Any abusive use may lead to suspension or removal of access.

sections.title: 4. Accounts and Steam authentication
sections.content: Sign-in relies on your Steam account. You are responsible for keeping your Steam credentials confidential and for any actions performed through your account within the application.

sections.title: 5. Notifications and content
sections.content: Notifications are generated from public sources or official Steam-related feeds. Their accuracy and availability are not guaranteed. GameNotif cannot be held responsible for content published by third parties.

sections.title: 6. Service availability
sections.content: We strive to keep the application available at all times, without guarantee. Temporary interruptions may occur for maintenance, updates, or force majeure.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.content: All graphics, text, logos, and features specific to GameNotif remain the property of their respective author. Steam and related assets are the property of Valve Corporation.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.content: GameNotif is provided "as is". We cannot be held liable for any direct or indirect damages resulting from the use of, or inability to use, the application.

sections.title: 9. Changes to the terms
sections.content: These Terms of Service may be changed at any time. The most recent version is always available in the application. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, you can write to: contact@fouzi-dev.fr.

sections.title: 1. Data collected
sections.content: We store only the information necessary to operate GameNotif: your Steam ID, your synced library (list of games with playtime), your recently active games history, your wishlist, the notification settings you configure in the application (enabled state, auto-follow, push notification token), as well as technical logs required to keep the service stable.

sections.title: 2. Use of data
sections.content: This data is used to sync your games, manage your follows, send relevant notifications, and improve the application's performance. It is never sold or used for advertising purposes.

sections.title: 3. Storage and retention
sections.content: Information is stored securely on our servers. It is kept for as long as your account remains active. You can delete your account directly from the application to erase your data.

sections.title: 4. Sharing with third parties
sections.content: No commercial sharing is carried out. Some data may transit through official Steam APIs in order to provide the service. These exchanges comply with Valve Corporation's policies.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.content: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the right to access, correct, object to, and delete your personal data. Contact contact@fouzi-dev.fr to exercise these rights.

sections.title: 6. Security
sections.content: Technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. Despite our efforts, no system is completely invulnerable.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.content: GameNotif does not use cookies or advertising trackers. The application keeps only a local technical cache on your device in order to speed up data display.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may evolve. Any update will be published in this section of the application. By continuing to use the service, you accept these changes.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.content: If you have any questions about the protection of your data, write to contact@fouzi-dev.fr. We will do our best to respond quickly.
